sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- A.S.G.I.,Arvind Kumar Goswami,C.S.C.
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Anish Kumar Gupta,J.
1.

The instructions received from Special Land Acquisition Officer (Joint Organization), Saharanpur,
are taken on record.

2. The instant petition has been filed praying for a writ of mandamus commanding the respondents to grant compensation to the petitioner for Plot Nos. 94 and 95 situated in village Ranpur @
Rampur (Nagal), Tehsil Deoband, District Saharanpur on account of same having been acquired by Indian Railways.

3. Sri Arvind Kumar Goswami, learned counsel appearing for respondent no. 1, has placed for our perusal an order dated 10.07.2017 by which lease of the aforesaid plots in favour of the petitioner was cancelled by the Collector, Saharanpur in exercise of powers under Section 198(4) of the U.P.
Zamindari Abolition and Land Reforms Act, 1950.
